---
name: Human test request
about: A test on real hardware or the phone that only the owner can run.
title: "Test T-NNN: "
labels: ["needs-human", "unverified"]
---

## Test card

Path to the card, for example `tests/hardware/T-001-pulse-offset.md`.

## Claims this settles

C-0NN, C-0NN

## What to send back

The numbers, files or photos the card's "Record" section lists.

## Result

Filled in when results arrive: pass, fail or measurement only, with the path in `tests/results/`.
